data.name: Let's Bake Bread,Chef Meow!
data.detailed_description:
"Let's Bake Bread,Chef Meow!" is a simulation baking game. You'll play as a cat owner of a bakery. Your customers are a group of adorable animals. Open the shop early in the morning to greet each lovely customer, making delicious bread and specialty drinks—whether it's soft toast, crispy croissants, or a fragrant cup of coffee or milk tea, you can handle it all. Flip through the rich menu and complete each order—it's full of fun and a sense of accomplishment.

Each customer has their own preferred tastes. Carefully observe their preferences and prepare their favorite breads in advance! The better you understand your customers, the easier it will be to run the business.

Don't forget to upgrade your equipment; this will make your orders run faster! Accumulate coins, unlock new areas, expand the menu, and carefully manage your own little shop.

Ready to open for business? Put on your apron, bake fragrant bread, neatly arrange the shelves, and welcome your animal customers. We hope "Let's Bake Bread,Chef Meow!" is a success! It will become a healing moment in your busy life~

data.short_description: "Let's Bake Bread,Chef Meow!" is a baking game where you play a cat in an apron, running your own cozy bakery. Start with simple rolls, unlock new ingredients and recipes, observe your customers' taste preferences, and satisfy their discerning palates—begin your warm, cozy journey!
